final: SELECT entrystat, AVG(site_avg_ram) AS avg_site_ram, AVG(site_avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) AS avg_site_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM (SELECT s.zoneref, si.entrystat, AVG(s.memusagegb) AS site_avg_ram, AVG(CAST(s.procgpu AS REAL) / NULLIF(s.proccpu, 0)) AS site_avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM scanprocessing AS s JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.memusagegb >= 60.8 GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.entrystat) GROUP BY entrystat
